jobs.title: UP Super TET 2026 – Assistant Teacher (Primary) Recruitment
jobs.org: Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC)
jobs.qualificationDetail: Graduation with the prescribed teacher-training qualification and a valid TET/CTET (primary level) as per UP Basic Education rules
jobs.ageNote: Relaxation for reserved categories as per rules
jobs.about: UPESSC is recruiting Assistant Teachers for government primary schools run by the UP Basic Education Board. Candidates who already hold a teacher-training qualification and have passed TET/CTET can apply. Selection is through the Super TET written exam.
steps: Visit upessc.up.gov.in and open the Super TET 2026 notice
Register with mobile number and email
Fill personal, academic and TET details
Pay the fee online before 15 October 2026
Submit and print the confirmation page

jobs.title: UP Special TET 2026 (Primary & Upper Primary)
jobs.org: Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC)
jobs.qualificationDetail: Teacher-training qualification as prescribed for the primary or upper-primary level paper
jobs.about: The UP Special TET is an eligibility test for teaching in primary (Classes 1–5) and upper-primary (Classes 6–8) schools in Uttar Pradesh. Passing it makes you eligible for future teacher recruitments; it is not itself a job. Applicants with D.El.Ed/B.Ed or equivalent training should apply.
selection: Written eligibility test (Paper for primary and/or upper primary)
steps: Go to upessc.up.gov.in and open the Special TET 2026 link
Choose primary/upper-primary level and fill details
Use the correction window (till 8 October) if needed and print the form

jobs.title: Kerala TET (K-TET) September 2026
jobs.qualificationDetail: Eligibility differs for Category I (LP), II (UP), III (High School) and IV (language/specialist teachers) as per the notification
jobs.examDate: Category I & II: 14 Nov 2026; Category III & IV: 15 Nov 2026
jobs.about: K-TET is the eligibility test required to teach in Kerala schools at the lower primary, upper primary, high school and specialist levels. It is a qualifying exam, not a direct recruitment. Students finishing TTC, D.El.Ed or B.Ed should take it.
steps: Print the application and later download the hall ticket

jobs.title: BPSC TRE 4.0 – School Teacher Recruitment 2026 (Advt. 15/2026)
jobs.qualificationDetail: Level-specific degree/diploma with B.Ed/D.El.Ed where applicable, plus CTET or Bihar STET/BTET for the relevant level
jobs.ageNote: Age as on 01.08.2026. Min 18 (Classes 1–8) or 21 (Classes 9–12). Max: UR male 37; UR female & BC/EBC 40; SC/ST 42; PwD +10 years
jobs.fee: ₹100 for all candidates (+₹200 biometric fee only if national ID number is not provided)
jobs.about: BPSC is recruiting school teachers for primary, middle, secondary and higher-secondary classes in Bihar government schools. The re-announced notification lists 32,388 posts (some reports say the count was raised to 33,320). Candidates with the right teacher training and TET for their level should apply.
steps: Go to bpsc.bihar.gov.in and read Advt. 15/2026
Fill the TRE 4.0 form and choose class level & subject
Upload photo, signature and TET details
Submit by 26 October 2026 and print the form
documents: Bihar residence & category certificate (if claiming reservation)

jobs.title: Karnataka Teacher Recruitment 2026 (GPSTR / HSTR / PET – 15,000 posts)
jobs.org: Department of School Education, Government of Karnataka
jobs.qualificationDetail: Post-wise qualification; valid KARTET or CTET where prescribed
jobs.ageNote: Relaxation for OBC/SC/ST as per Karnataka rules
jobs.about: Karnataka is filling about 15,000 teacher posts in government primary and high schools, including Graduate Primary Teachers, Assistant Masters and Physical Education Teachers. Selection combines a written CET with TET score and academic marks. Trained teachers with KARTET/CTET should apply.
steps: Visit schooleducation.karnataka.gov.in and read the district notifications
Fill post, subject and district preferences
Pay the fee (fee window closed 10 Sept 2026)

jobs.title: MP Teacher Eligibility Test (MPTET) Varg 2 & Varg 3 2026
jobs.qualificationDetail: Varg 2 for middle-school (secondary) teachers; Varg 3 for primary teachers, with prescribed training qualifications
jobs.about: MPESB conducts MPTET Varg 2 (middle school) and Varg 3 (primary school) eligibility tests for teaching jobs in Madhya Pradesh. Passing the test is required for future MP government teacher recruitment. The exam is a 150-mark computer-based paper.
steps: Visit esb.mp.gov.in and read the MPTET notice
Print the form; download admit card before the exam

jobs.title: JSSC JTAACCE 2026 – Assistant Acharya (Para Teacher) Recruitment
jobs.qualificationDetail: Intermediate Trained Assistant Teacher (Classes 1–5) and Graduate Trained Assistant Teacher (Classes 6–8); 6,101 regular + 1,198 backlog posts
jobs.ageNote: Maximum 35–40 years depending on category, as per notification
jobs.about: JSSC is recruiting Assistant Acharyas from among para teachers for Jharkhand government primary and upper-primary schools. There are 7,299 posts across Intermediate-trained and Graduate-trained levels. Eligible para teachers with the required training and TET should apply.
steps: Read the JTAACCE-2026 notice on jssc.jharkhand.gov.in
Open the online application link from the JSSC site
Register and fill academic, training and service details
Submit by 18 October 2026 and print the form

jobs.title: CG Vyapam Lecturer (Vyakhyata) Recruitment 2026 – E & T Cadre
jobs.qualificationDetail: Master’s degree in the relevant subject with B.Ed
jobs.ageNote: Age as on 01.01.2026. Up to 5 yrs relaxation for CG SC/ST/OBC, up to 10 yrs for women, PwD as per GAD rules
jobs.about: CG Vyapam is recruiting 854 Lecturers for higher-secondary government schools in Chhattisgarh under the E and T cadres. Postgraduates with B.Ed in the relevant subject can apply. Selection is through a written exam.
steps: Register/log in and open the Lecturer 2026 form
Fill personal, PG and B.Ed details
Submit by 26 October 2026 (corrections 27–29 Oct) and print

jobs.title: AIIMS NORCET 11 – Nursing Officer Recruitment 2026
jobs.org: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi
jobs.qualificationDetail: B.Sc (Hons)/B.Sc Nursing, or GNM diploma with experience as prescribed; registration with Nursing Council
jobs.ageNote: Age as on 13.08.2026; relaxation as per Government of India rules
jobs.examDate: Stage I: 12 Sept 2026; Stage II: 30 Sept 2026
jobs.about: NORCET is the common exam AIIMS uses to hire Nursing Officers (Group B) for AIIMS institutes across India. NORCET 11 has 2,218 vacancies. Nurses with B.Sc Nursing or GNM and registration should apply.
steps: Upload photo, signature and nursing registration

jobs.title: ESIC Nursing Officer Recruitment 2026 (through NORCET-11)
jobs.qualificationDetail: As per ESIC recruitment rules; candidates must appear in AIIMS NORCET-11
jobs.ageNote: OBC +3, SC/ST +5, PwBD +10 years
jobs.examDate: NORCET-11 Stage I: 12 Sept 2026; Stage II: 30 Sept 2026
jobs.fee: ₹3,000 (General/OBC); ₹2,400 (SC/ST/female); exempt for PwBD (paid in NORCET application)
jobs.about: ESIC is filling 523 Nursing Officer posts in its hospitals using scores from AIIMS NORCET-11. You apply by registering for NORCET-11 and opting for ESIC. Nursing graduates and GNM holders can apply.
steps: Read the ESIC Nursing Officer notice on esic.gov.in
Choose ESIC as a participating institute
Upload documents and pay the NORCET fee

jobs.title: PGIMER Chandigarh Nursing Officer Recruitment 2026
jobs.org: Post Graduate Institute of Medical Education & Research, Chandigarh
jobs.qualificationDetail: As per PGIMER notification
jobs.about: PGIMER Chandigarh, a premier central government hospital, is recruiting 243 Nursing Officers. Registered nurses with B.Sc Nursing or GNM can apply online. Check the official notice for fee, age and exam details.
steps: Visit pgimer.edu.in and open the Nursing Officer advertisement

jobs.title: RUHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 (Rajasthan)
jobs.org: Rajasthan University of Health Sciences (for Medical & Health Dept., Rajasthan)
jobs.qualificationDetail: MBBS with registration in Rajasthan Medical Council
jobs.ageNote: Age as on 01.01.2027; relaxation as per Rajasthan rules
jobs.about: RUHS is conducting recruitment for 600 Medical Officer posts in Rajasthan’s government health services. MBBS doctors registered with the Rajasthan Medical Council can apply. Applications are open from 14 September to 13 October 2026.
steps: Visit ruhsraj.org and read the MO 2026 notice
Upload photo, signature and RMC registration

jobs.title: HPPSC Medical Officer (General Wing) Recruitment 2026 – Advt. 62/9-2026
jobs.qualificationDetail: MBBS from a recognised institution with registration as per notification
jobs.ageNote: Relaxation for reserved categories as per rules
jobs.about: HPPSC is recruiting 228 Medical Officers (Group A, Job Trainee) for the Health & Family Welfare Department of Himachal Pradesh. MBBS graduates can apply online. Initial appointment is as a job trainee.
selection: Screening test / interview as per HPPSC rules
steps: Upload photo, signature and MBBS documents

jobs.title: NHM Haryana Community Health Officer (CHO) Recruitment 2026
jobs.qualificationDetail: As prescribed for Mid-Level Health Provider-cum-Community Health Officer
jobs.about: NHM Haryana is hiring 328 Community Health Officers (Mid-Level Health Providers) for Health & Wellness Centres. These are contractual posts that run primary health services in villages. Nursing/BAMS graduates meeting the criteria could apply.
steps: Visit nrhmharyana.gov.in and open the CHO 2026 notice
Download admit card for the CBT

jobs.title: GSSSB Staff Nurse (Class-3) Recruitment 2026 – ESIS
jobs.qualificationDetail: B.Sc Nursing or General Nursing & Midwifery with registration
jobs.ageNote: Relaxation for reserved categories as per rules
jobs.about: GSSSB is recruiting 131 Staff Nurses (Class-3) for the Employees’ State Insurance Scheme hospitals under Gujarat’s Health Department. Nurses with B.Sc Nursing or GNM can apply through OJAS.
steps: Confirm the application and pay the fee

jobs.title: UPSSSC Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET) 2026
jobs.org: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission
jobs.qualificationDetail: High School (10th) or equivalent
jobs.ageNote: Age as on 01.07.2026; relaxation as per UP rules
jobs.about: PET is the mandatory screening test for most Group C jobs in Uttar Pradesh. Your PET score lets you apply for later UPSSSC recruitments. Anyone with 10th pass aged 18–40 can take it.
selection: Scorecard valid for UPSSSC mains recruitments

jobs.title: UPSSSC Forensic Science Laboratory – Scientific & Lab Assistant Recruitment 2026
jobs.org: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission
jobs.qualificationDetail: Science degree in subjects specified for Scientific Assistant / Laboratory Assistant
jobs.ageNote: Age as on 01.07.2026; UP SC/ST/OBC +5 years
jobs.about: UPSSSC is recruiting 208 Scientific Assistants and Laboratory Assistants for UP’s Forensic Science Laboratories. Science graduates in the relevant subjects could apply. The last date is reported differently by sources (17 or 24 August 2026).
steps: Visit upsssc.gov.in and read the FSL advertisement

jobs.title: UPPSC Recruitment 2026 – Computer Operator, Microbiologist & Other Posts (Advt. A-2/E-1/2026, A-3/E-1/2026)
jobs.qualificationDetail: Varies by post: Computer Operator Grade-B, Programmer, Manager (System), Microbiologist and others
jobs.about: UPPSC released two advertisements for 47 posts including Computer Operator Grade-B, Programmer and Microbiologist in UP government departments. Eligibility depends on the post. One Time Registration is compulsory.
selection: Screening test / interview as per post
steps: Visit uppsc.up.nic.in and read the advertisement
Select the post and fill the form
Make corrections till 10 September if needed

jobs.title: UKPSC Combined State Civil / Upper Subordinate Services (Upper PCS) 2026
jobs.qualificationDetail: Bachelor’s degree; some posts need specific degrees (e.g. Commerce/CA for audit posts)
jobs.ageNote: Age as on 01.07.2026; relaxation as per Uttarakhand rules
jobs.about: This is Uttarakhand’s state civil services exam for 67 posts across 16 services, including Deputy Collector, DSP, Finance Officer and BDO. Any graduate aged 21–42 can apply. A correction window runs 7–16 October 2026.
steps: Visit psc.uk.gov.in and read the Upper PCS notice
Submit and print; use the correction window if needed

jobs.title: MPESB Group-3 Sub Engineer, Draftsman & Equivalent Recruitment 2026
jobs.qualificationDetail: ITI, diploma or degree in the relevant engineering trade as per post
jobs.ageNote: Up to 45 for reserved categories
jobs.about: MPESB is filling 1,700 Group-3 technical posts such as Sub Engineer, Draftsman and Lab Technician in MP government departments. ITI, diploma or engineering degree holders in the relevant trade could apply. Selection is through a computer-based test.
steps: Visit esb.mp.gov.in and read the Group-3 Sub Engineer notice
Fill the form and choose posts

jobs.title: RSSB Junior Engineer (JEN) Recruitment 2026 – Advt. 10/2026
jobs.qualificationDetail: Degree or diploma in Civil/Mechanical/Electrical engineering as per post (PWD, Water Resources, PHED)
jobs.ageNote: Age as on 01.01.2027; +1 year general relaxation; 5 yrs for Rajasthan SC/ST/OBC/MBC/EWS males & General women
jobs.about: RSSB is recruiting 874 Junior Engineers for Rajasthan’s PWD, Water Resources and PHED departments. Civil, Mechanical and Electrical diploma/degree holders could apply. Selection is by written exam.
steps: Open Recruitment Portal and complete OTR

jobs.title: TNPSC Combined Civil Services Exam – II (Group 2 & 2A) 2026
jobs.qualificationDetail: Any degree; some posts need specific qualifications
jobs.ageNote: Varies by post; no upper age limit (max 60) for SC/ST/BC/MBC/DC categories
jobs.fee: One-Time Registration ₹150 + Prelims fee ₹100 (concessions as per rules)
jobs.about: TNPSC Group 2 and 2A (Notification 07/2026) fills interview and non-interview posts such as Sub-Registrar, Assistant and Revenue posts in Tamil Nadu. 821 vacancies were notified (some later reports say 846). Any graduate can apply.
steps: Complete One Time Registration on tnpsc.gov.in

jobs.title: TNPSC Combined Technical Services Exam (Interview Posts) 2026 – Notification 8/2026
jobs.qualificationDetail: Post-wise technical/professional degrees for 31 posts
jobs.about: TNPSC is recruiting for 170 vacancies across 31 technical, professional and managerial posts (such as Research Assistant and Assistant Manager). Graduates and postgraduates with the post-specific qualification can apply. Selection is by written exam and interview.

jobs.title: KPSC Gazetted Probationers (KAS) Group A & B Recruitment 2026
jobs.qualificationDetail: Bachelor’s degree from a recognised university
jobs.ageNote: 2A/2B/3A/3B: 43; SC/ST/Cat-1: 45; plus one-time 5-year relaxation for all categories
jobs.about: KPSC’s Gazetted Probationers exam recruits Karnataka Administrative Service and other Group A & B officers. 319 posts were notified. Graduates within the age limit could apply (last date was extended to 7 September).
steps: Register / log in to the KPSC portal

jobs.title: APPSC Group-I Services Recruitment 2026
jobs.qualificationDetail: Bachelor’s degree; post-specific requirements apply
jobs.ageNote: Relaxation for reserved categories as per rules
jobs.fee: ₹370 (₹250 processing + ₹120 exam); ₹250 for SC/ST/BC/PwBD (exam fee exempt)
jobs.about: APPSC Group-I recruits top state officers such as Deputy Collector and DSP across 13 services; 163 vacancies are notified. Any graduate aged 18–42 can apply. Applications open 6 October 2026.
steps: Visit psc.ap.gov.in and read the Group-I notification

jobs.title: WBPSC West Bengal Civil Service (Exe.) Exam – September 2026 Notification
jobs.qualificationDetail: Degree from a recognised university
jobs.ageNote: Group A & C: 21–36; Group B (WB Police): 20–36; Group D: 21–39; relaxation as per rules
jobs.fee: ₹210 + service charge; exempt for WB SC/ST and PwBD (40%+)
jobs.about: WBCS (Exe.) recruits officers for West Bengal’s Group A, B, C and D civil services. Any graduate within the age limits can apply. Vacancy numbers are in the official notice.
steps: Visit psc.wb.gov.in and read the WBCS notice
Register on the WBPSC online portal
Fill the form and choose groups

jobs.title: OPSC Assistant Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026 – Advt. 09 of 2026-27
jobs.qualificationDetail: Bachelor’s degree in Law, at least 2 years’ practice as an advocate, and knowledge of Odia
jobs.ageNote: Upper age 42 as on 01.01.2026; relaxation as per Odisha rules
jobs.about: OPSC is recruiting 172 Assistant Public Prosecutors (Group B) for Odisha’s Home Department, including 58 posts for women. Law graduates with two years of practice and Odia knowledge could apply.
steps: Register on the OPSC online portal

jobs.title: HPPSC HP Administrative Services (HPAS) Combined Competitive Exam 2026
jobs.qualificationDetail: Bachelor’s degree from a recognised university
jobs.ageNote: Age counted from 1 January; relaxation as per HP rules
jobs.about: HPAS is Himachal Pradesh’s state civil services exam for posts such as HPAS officer, Tehsildar and BDO; 22 vacancies are notified. Graduates aged 21–35 could apply.

jobs.title: Kerala PSC Notifications – Extraordinary Gazette 30.09.2026 (Cat. No. 151–161/2026)
jobs.qualificationDetail: Includes Draftsman Gr-II, HSST (Statistics, Arabic), Police Constable Driver, Peon/Watchman (KSFE), Forest Boat Driver and more
jobs.about: Kerala PSC notified 11 categories (151–161/2026) covering posts such as Draftsman, Higher Secondary School Teacher, Police Constable Driver and Peon/Watchman. Several are special or NCA recruitments for specific communities. Read each category’s eligibility before applying.
steps: Register or log in on the Thulasi portal (thulasi.psc.kerala.gov.in)
Click “Apply Now” for the category number

jobs.title: GPSC Class 1 & 2 Recruitment 2026 (Advt. 42/2026-27 to 56/2026-27)
jobs.qualificationDetail: Posts include Marine Engineer, Engineer Surveyor, Port Officer, Pilot Officer, Naval Architect, Manager and others
jobs.about: GPSC has released 15 advertisements for 26 Class 1 and Class 2 posts, mostly technical maritime and managerial roles in Gujarat government. Eligibility depends on the post. Applications are through OJAS.
selection: Preliminary test / interview as per post
steps: Complete One Time Registration on gpsc-ojas.gujarat.gov.in
Select the advertisement and fill details
Pay ₹100 online or by challan (till 9 Oct)

jobs.title: India Post Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) Recruitment 2026 – Schedule II (July 2026)
jobs.org: Department of Posts, Ministry of Communications
jobs.qualificationDetail: 10th pass with Mathematics and English, knowledge of local language and basic computer skills
jobs.ageNote: OBC up to 43, SC/ST up to 45; PwD as per rules
jobs.examDate: No exam – merit list based on 10th marks
jobs.fee: ₹100 (General/OBC/EWS male); exempt for women, SC/ST, PwBD
jobs.salary: TRCA as per GDS rules (BPM / ABPM / Dak Sevak)
jobs.about: India Post is engaging 23,757 Gramin Dak Sevaks (Branch Postmaster, Assistant Branch Postmaster and Dak Sevak) in rural post offices. There is no exam – selection is on 10th-class marks. Registration closed 19 Sept and application closed 21 Sept 2026.
steps: Register with mobile number and email
Fill the application and choose division/post preferences
Submit and print; use the edit window if allowed
